scripts.redis:start: node -e "const net = require('net'); const s = net.createServer(so => { so.on('data', d => d.toString().toUpperCase().includes('PING') ? so.write('+PONG\r\n') : so.write('+OK\r\n')); so.on('error', () => {}); }); s.listen(6379, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log('✅ Redis listening on 127.0.0.1:6379'));"
